welcome.getStartedDesc: Create a new session or manage your saved connections
welcome.tip1: Add a server in the <1>Connection Manager</1> (left sidebar), then double-click to connect
welcome.tip2: Split the terminal with <1>⌘\</1> (right) or <3>⌘⇧\</3> (down) for side-by-side sessions
